Long ago, on the Island of Sounds, there grew a magic World Flower.
Every petal was a sound. With sounds, we could talk, and read, and sing!
Words, words, WORDS! How I HATE them!
I am Baron Muddle! Every sound on this island is MINE! Mwa-ha-ha-ha!
Oh no! The petals blew away, all over the island!
The World Flower has gone dark. Now nobody can read!
We need a hero. We need... a Super Ninja!
Win back every petal, one sound at a time!
I am Sensei Maple. I will train you. Now, choose your ninja!
Great choice! Let's rescue those sounds!

Baron Muddle has mixed up these words! Can you fix them? Change one sound at a time.

Sorting time! These words have the same sound, but it's written in different ways. Put each word in the right chest!
Sorted! What a clever ninja.
Story time! I'll read, and you read too.

Let's think about the story...

You won back a sound!
You won back some sounds!
You found every sound in this land! Let's go to the next one!
Great ninja training today! Now, go and read a book with a grown-up.
You did it, Super Ninja! Every petal is back on the World Flower. The whole island can read and spell again!
This is the World Flower! Every petal is a sound. The gems inside are all the different ways to spell it.
This is the World Flower. Baron Muddle blew all its petals away!
Every petal is one sound. Listen! This is the petal for the sound...
Inside each petal are shiny gems. Each gem is a way to write the sound.
When you play and get it right, a gem fills up with ninja power.
When a gem is full, it glows. Then you can win it in a gem battle!
Win all the gems in a petal, and the petal flies back onto the World Flower!

The World Flower is glowing again! You are a true Super Ninja!

Whenever you're stuck, tap me! I'm always here in the corner, and I'll tell you what to do. Try it now. Tap me!
That's it! And if you're still stuck, tap me again, and again, and I'll give you bigger clues.

You're ready, ninja! Let's go!
This part is for grown-ups. Hold the button to open.
Mwa-ha-ha... I hid THAT sound very well, little ninja.
Muddle... muddle... muddle. Your sounds belong to ME now!
Silence! No more words! Not ever!
Grrrr... You dare to fight ME?
Nooo! My muddle! This is not over, ninja... I will be back!
So... a little ninja wants to stop me? My sumo panda will squash you!
My big red monster is hungry, ninja. Hungry... for SOUNDS!
In my mountains, every word freezes solid. Mwa-ha-ha!
My river dragon gobbles up sounds. Slurp! Mwa-ha-ha!
Welcome to my castle, little ninja! In here, some sounds are spelt with two letters. How muddling! Mwa-ha-ha!
So. You came all this way. Same sound, different spellings? That was my best muddle of all! Grrr!
Oh... Well... I suppose words ARE rather nice. Especially... stories. Sorry for all the muddle.
In Bamboo Village, the pandas were having a terrible day. Baron Muddle had pinched their lunch pot and hidden it! But Super Ninja had a clue...
The map showed a twisty path, deep into the bamboo. Super Ninja crept along, quiet as a mouse.
Two places to look! Where is the pot hidden?
Shhh! Let's tiptoe away and let Pip the panda sleep. Try the other place!
The pandas cheered and gobbled up every last dumpling. And look! Inside the pot was a glowing sound petal.
What did Baron Muddle hide?
Up on Blossom Hills lived a little hen called Peg. One morning, Baron Muddle blew a big grey fog over the hills, and poor Peg got lost!
Super Ninja followed a trail of feathers through the fog. The trail led to two places...
Where is Peg?
The pig only had one feather. Cheeky pig! Let's look in the other place.
Super Ninja carried Peg all the way home. The fog melted away, and Peg was so happy that she laid a golden egg... with a sound petal inside!
Who was lost in the fog?
High in the Misty Mountains lived a little yak called Rex. Baron Muddle had pinched Rex's bell, so now his mum couldn't find him in the mist!
Super Ninja heard a faint ding-dong, far away. Across a wobbly rope bridge they went, and then...
Where is the bell?
The spider waved all eight legs hello. Friendly, but no bell! Try the other place.
Ding-dong! Rex's mum heard the bell and came galloping through the mist. And tied to the bell's ribbon was a sound petal!
What did Rex lose?
On Dragon River, Frog wanted to get to the other side, to visit his gran. But Baron Muddle had smashed all the stepping stones!
Super Ninja had a plan: make a log into a boat! But what could hold the sticks on?
What will hold the sticks on?
Splodge! Jam is yummy, but it's no good for building boats. Try again!
They drifted all the way across Dragon River. Frog's gran was waiting on the far bank, with a sound petal!
What did they ride across the river?
Deep inside Shadow Castle, Baron Muddle kept his treasure chest, stuffed full of stolen sound petals. Super Ninja crept in through a window...
But the chest was locked with a muddle-lock. How could Super Ninja open it?
What should Super Ninja do?
Ouch, that hurt a ninja toe! A muddle-lock needs a gentle touch. Try again.
Petals whooshed out of the chest like a rainbow snowstorm, flying home to the World Flower. Now only the Sky Temple is left...
Where was the chest?
At the very top of the Sky Temple, Baron Muddle sat all alone, holding the very last petal. He didn't look muddly at all. He looked... sad.
Why are you so grumpy, Baron? asked Super Ninja. The Baron sniffed. Nobody ever reads ME a story...
Which story will you read to the Baron?
And with a happy sniff, the Baron gave back the very last petal. The World Flower burst into bloom, and the whole island filled with sounds, words and stories once more. The end!
What made the Baron happy?
